declarations.name: AuiRating
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Rating: `<aui-rating>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text, referenced by the control.

inputs.name: clearable
inputs.description: Choosing the current value again, Delete, Backspace, or 0 clears the rating.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and announced, but not changeable.

inputs.name: display
inputs.description: Non-interactive display (role=img with the value text).

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Visible caption per whole step, such as 'Good'.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name (hidden input; empty when no rating).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the value text and messages.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the score: { value, validity }.

outputs.name: hovered
outputs.description: The pointer previews a value (null when it leaves): { value }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear the validation state.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Slider: one focusable role=slider with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin (0 when clearable), aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext such as '3.5 of 5'. Chosen over the radio group pattern because half steps and clearing are one value on a range and the control is a single tab stop. Display mode is role=img named by the label and the value text.

limitations: Half steps are the finest granularity.
